content.text: I reviewed the brief line by line against the 8-K Exhibit 99.1.

facts.evidence: Revenue for the second quarter of fiscal 2027 was $96.2 billion, up 18% from the previous quarter and 106% from a year ago.
GAAP and non-GAAP earnings per diluted share were $2.46 and $2.22, respectively.
Data Center revenue reached $89.0 billion, up 18% from the previous quarter and 117% from a year ago.
GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins for the quarter were both 75.0%. (The brief gives the level correctly on both bases but omits the +2.6 pt year-over-year GAAP change.)
Revenue for the third quarter of fiscal 2027 is expected to be $108.0 billion, plus or minus 2%, with no Data Center compute revenue from China assumed in this outlook.
The company reported the Vera Rubin platform is in full production and the Groq 3 LPX is in full production. (Full-production status is correct; the brief does not name the partner racks.)

The company returned approximately $26.0 billion to shareholders in the form of shares repurchased and cash dividends during the second quarter of fiscal 2027. / As of the end of the second quarter, approximately $99.0 billion remained under the share repurchase authorization.
Edge Computing revenue was $7.2 billion, up 13% from the previous quarter and 27% from a year ago.
